results.name: Advanced Micro Devices Inc.
results.description: Advanced Micro Devices Inc. operates as a semiconductor company worldwide.The company designs, develops, and sells microprocessors, such as central processing unit (CPU) and accelerated processing unit (APU) for desktop PCs, notebooks, etc. The company was incorporated on May 1, 1969.

results.name: Arrow Minerals Ltd.
results.description: Arrow Minerals Ltd. (formerly Segue Resources Ltd.) engages in the exploration of gold, lithium, and nickel. The company was founded on January 21, 2005

results.name: Amiad Water Systems Ltd.
results.description: Amiad Water Systems Ltd. formerly Amiad Filtration Systems Ltd. together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and supply of water filters and filtration systems for the industrial, municipal, and irrigation markets worldwide. It was incorporated in 1962.

results.name: Banco Amazonas S.A.
results.description: Banco Amazonas S.A. is an Ecuador-based financial institution principally engaged in the banking sector. The bank's services and products include saving and current accounts and fixed-term deposits, among others. The company was incorporated on January 31, 1975.

results.name: Advanced Material Development Ltd.
results.description: Advanced Material Development Ltd. (doing business as AMD) is a British private company. The firm provides equity funding services and engages in research & development of nano-materials. Provides equity funding services and engages in research & development of nano-materials.
